|game_text=Slip on the Decipher card ''Endor: Great Forest (Light)''<br />'''Light:''' At start of your turn, may draw a card from top of Reserve Deck for each Kashyyyk site where all your ability is provided only by Wookiees.<br />'''Dark:''' Unless Mosep on table, Force lost from your Force drains here must come from hand, if possible.
